description: Get Form 5500 filing detail from the DOL EFAST2 index. Pass ack_id for a single filing (sponsor, plan name/number, participant counts, begin/end-of-year plan assets, plan type, filing date, and full filing PDF URL). Pass ein instead to get a plan sponsor's full filing history (all Form 5500 filings for that EIN, newest first). Note: line-item detail such as Schedule C service providers is not in the search index — the returned pdf_url links to the complete filing.

ack_id.description: EFAST2 Acknowledgement ID (the 30-char filing id, e.g. "20230407122300NAL0001820321001"). Returns one filing.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number (9 digits, dashes optional). Returns the full filing history for that employer.

limit.description: For ein history: max filings to return (1-200, default 50).

name: form5500_filing
title: Form5500 Filing
